sub_palette: nguni_bantu (Zulu; a distinct register whose DEITY morphs are seeded from the Ge'ez/Axumite set per Jedidiah, then shifted into Nguni phonology)
_note: Single-source (Southern African Nguni/Bantu, Shakan era; §5.1 #22). Honor-bound CHAOTIC raiders of the savanna and jungle: the amabutho (age-regiment) host under the iNgonyama, disciplined yet Chaotic. Nguni/Zulu phonology (clicks, prenasalized stops, the hl/dl laterals, CV syllables, noun-class prefixes um-/aba-/isi-/ama-/i-) and the real Zulu rulership/kin register (inkosi, induna, iNgonyama, isizwe, umbuso, amabutho - allowed, catalog 5.3). DEITY names are SEEDED from the Ge'ez/Axumite set (the canon morphs of the Agrippan pantheon - Marakos, Warlandos, Wak'idos, Matansa, Numanos, Talros, Riyalta, Atyarna) and SHIFTED into Nguni phonology (per Jedidiah): Marakos -> uMarakela, Warlandos -> uWalandela, Wak'idos -> uVakida, Matansa -> uMatansa. Never real Zulu/African holy names. Faith is ANCESTOR-FIRST and totemic: the amadlozi (ancestral shades) venerated daily through the isangoma; the Chaotic war/death/storm powers prominent; the One (uThangela) remote and unpetitioned; clan/regiment totems (Lion, Buffalo).

phonology.palette: Nguni/Zulu (Bantu): click consonants c(dental)/q(palatal)/x(lateral) and their nasal/voiced variants; prenasalized stops mb/nd/ng/nj; lateral fricatives hl/dl; aspirated ph/th/kh; voiced bh/dh; CV(N) syllables, no consonant clusters but the nasal+stop onsets; penultimate vowel-lengthening stress; noun-class prefixes um-/aba- (people), isi-/izi- (manner/thing), ama- (collective), i(li)-/ama- ; theophoric stems are the Nguni-shifted Ge'ez canon morphs (uMarakela-, uWalandela-, uVakida-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV and NCV (prenasalized); clicks as full consonants; no codas except nasals; all words vowel-final; reduplication for intensives.

kinship.ancestor: idlozi (pl. amadlozi, the ancestral shades) / inyanya (the great forebear)

toponymic_suffixes: kwa- (place of / at the home of)
morphology.patronymic_form: filiation 'ka-X' (child of X): Dingane kaSenzangakhona; praise-names (izibongo) earned in war stack onto the given name; the clan name (isibongo) marks lineage; no foreign-style surname.

gendered_endings.female: often u-/no- prefixed; -kazi (the female/great suffix: indlovukazi = she-elephant, queen-mother)

morphology.compounding_rule: verb/quality + class-prefix: Bhekizizwe (watch-the-nations), Nandi (the sweet-one); place via kwa-[name] (at the home of) and e-[feature]-ini (locative); the -kazi augment for the great/female.

title_ladder.government: clan_confederation - the amabutho host: the iNgonyama (the Lion-king) over the iziNduna and the regiments (amabutho), binding many isizwe (clan-nations) by conquest and the cattle-bond; the isangoma (diviners) counsel but do not rule.
title_ladder._tiers_note: Nguni/Zulu, ascending. iNduna (headman) barony, over one umuzi-ward; iNduna yeMpi (war-induna) march, holding an iKhanda war-kraal; iNkosana (sub-chief) county; iNkosi (chief of a clan-nation) duchy, over an isiZwe; iLembe (the great blade - the conquering warlord) principality; iNgonyama (the Lion - the king) kingdom; iNdlovu (the Great Elephant) empire, the horde-king over many nations (Izizwe). thrall and common warrior are not governing ranks (see non_governing). (Rank titles are the real Zulu register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: iNkosana (the chosen son / heir of the great house)

honorifics.your_majesty: Bayede! (the royal salute, to the iNgonyama alone)

people_name_convention.order: given name (a meaningful Nguni phrase, or theophoric on a power) + filiation ka-X (child of X) + clan name (isibongo); the renowned accrue praise-names (izibongo) chanted by the imbongi.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the royal house and iziNduna carry a clan name + war praise-names; commoners use given + ka-father.
people_name_convention.theophoric: war-born and diviner-born names invoke a power or the ancestors: Marakela- (war-born, of the Slaughter-power), Dlozi- / -odlozi (of the ancestors), Nomana- (storm-born). e.g. Marakelendlovu, Sodlozi, Nomanakhulu.

religion._note: ANCESTOR-FIRST and totemic, CHAOTIC. Daily faith is the amadlozi (the ancestral shades), reached through the isangoma (diviner) and inyanga (herbalist-shaman) by sacrifice of cattle in the isibaya. Above the ancestors stand the Chaotic powers - foremost the war and death powers - whose names are the Ge'ez/Axumite canon morphs SHIFTED into Nguni: never real Zulu/African gods. The One (uThangela < Atyarna) is the remote First-Out who made the world and withdrew; the Chaotic do not petition Him. Clans and regiments bear beast-totems (the Lion iNgonyama, the Buffalo iNyathi). The warrior swears by the spear (uWalandela) and the ancestors; to break a war-oath is the deepest shame.
religion.the_one: uThangela (< Atyarna / Axumite; the remote Sky-Father, the First-Out who withdrew; unpetitioned)

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: uMarakela (the Slaughter-Bringer, war-fire; foremost of the raiders)
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: uWalandela (the Iron-Spear, the oath of the regiment; Warlandos-shifted)
sample_deity_renames.Vacidus: uVakida (the Devouring Dark, death and the grave; Wak'idos-shifted)
sample_deity_renames.Metensia: uMatansa (the Wasting - drought and disease, appeased not loved)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: uNomana (the Sky-Winds, the storm and the lightning)
sample_deity_renames.Realta: uRiyala (the Earth-Mother, the cattle and the grain)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: for this Chaotic people the WAR and DEATH powers are venerated, not demonized; instead the distant Lawful powers are the cold, meddling sky-strangers - uThalosa-shifted as the Burning-Eye that withers the bold, the Lawful order-powers as the chains the free hosts threw off.

clergy_ladder.9: umlozikazi omkhulu (the great voice of the ancestors)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: no temples; the rites are at the isibaya (cattle-fold) and the ancestral graves: 'the diviners of [power/ancestor]', 'the spear-sworn of uWalandela'.
religion.saints_pattern: the great war-dead and founding forebears become izinyanya (mighty ancestral shades), named in the izibongo and fed at the kraal: 'iNyanya [name]' (the forebear [name]).

holy_symbol_motifs.uMarakela: a red iklwa (stabbing-spear) crossed over a war-shield
holy_symbol_motifs.uWalandela: an iron spearhead bound with the oath-thong
holy_symbol_motifs.amadlozi: the cattle-horn and the imphepho (the sacred smoke)

banks_patterns.war_regiments: the amabutho take fierce praise-names: 'the iziCwe (the Slashers)', 'the uFasimba (the Haze)', 'the iziNyosi (the Bees)', 'the iMpi kaMarakela'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [praise] iButho / the [color] shields: 'the White-Shields (amaHlophe)', 'the Buffalo-horn host (impondo zenyathi)'
banks_patterns.taverns_gatherings: the beer-gathering (idili / utshwala): 'the Great Cattle-feast', 'the iNdaba-fire'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: burnt kraals and ancestral grave-groves: 'the burnt iKhanda of [name]', 'the grave-grove (idlinza) of iNyanya [name]', 'the bone-veld of [battle]'

flagship_settlements: kwaBulawayo (the place of the killing - the war-capital)
